lanlink.title: Open to LAN
lanlink.online_mode.tooltip:
On: players must be signed in to Minecraft.
Off: anyone can join with any username.
lanlink.online_mode.on: Online mode enabled - players must be signed in to Minecraft.
lanlink.online_mode.off: Online mode disabled - anyone can join with any username.
lanlink.public.tooltip: Gives you a shareable internet address so friends anywhere can join. No port forwarding needed.
lanlink.status.active.hint: Friends: Multiplayer -> Direct Connection -> paste the address.
lanlink.status.connecting.hint: This usually takes a few seconds.
lanlink.status.failed.hint: Friends on your Wi-Fi can still join via LAN.
lanlink.status.pending: A public address is created when you start LAN.
lanlink.status.off: Public sharing is off - only players on your Wi-Fi can join.
lanlink.published: World opened to the internet! Share this address - click it to copy: %s
lanlink.published.lan: Same Wi-Fi friends: this direct address is instant: %s
lanlink.published.tailscale: Friends with Tailscale: use this address for fast ping: %s
lanlink.published.ipv6: Direct IPv6 address (fastest - use if your internet has IPv6): %s
lanlink.published.backup: Alternative address (only works if your network can resolve it): %s
lanlink.tunnel_failed: Could not get a public address: %s - friends on your Wi-Fi can still join via LAN.
lanlink.lan_only: Public sharing is off - only players on your Wi-Fi can join.
lanlink.keepalive.toast: World is still running for friends
lanlink.keepalive.toast.detail: Friends stay connected. Use the LAN Link button on the title screen to rejoin or stop it.
lanlink.keepalive.button.tooltip:
LAN Link: "%s" is still running for friends.
Click to rejoin, copy the address or stop it.
lanlink.keepalive.title: World open in background
lanlink.keepalive.online.none: No friends online right now - they can still join.
lanlink.keepalive.address.none: No address yet - the world is still starting up.
lanlink.keepalive.hint: Friends join with vanilla Minecraft: Multiplayer -> Direct Connection.
lanlink.keepalive.info: You left the world, but it keeps running for friends. It closes when you stop it here or close Minecraft.
lanlink.keepalive.rejoin.failed: The background world is no longer running.
